args.name: Search for ripe berries
args.function: Physically search the nearby area for red berry plants and collect available ripe berries from an accessible plant, stopping if none can be found within a bounded search.
args.conditions: I am outdoors at (131.1,16.91), healthy, with 80 satiety, 40 energy and no inventory. Red berries are known to provide 8 nutrition with zero toxicity. The berry plants currently observed have zero stock. Unknown foods must not be eaten. Search must respect obstacles, real distance, actual plant stock and other people's possessions.
args.inputs: Nearby terrain and berry plants encountered through actual travel; no tools are currently owned. Limit the search to a distance and energy budget that leaves a safe reserve, and collect no more than four ripe berries.
args.costs: Travel, observation and harvesting costs are not fully known; specify feasible costs and a bounded search before execution. No creation of food or accelerated growth is requested.
args.effects: Discover reachable berry sources through physical observation and, only if ripe stock is present and collection is feasible, transfer a limited amount of that stock to my inventory. Report an unsuccessful search honestly. Implementation alone does not perform the search or grant mastery.

response.text: {"queries":[],"result_json":"{\"reviews\":[{\"actor\":\"kai\",\"decision\":\"develop\",\"ability\":null,\"reason\":\"Develop the missing bounded search-and-collection controller, not new movement, observation or harvesting mechanics. The related-capability search was exhausted: navigate travels to a chosen known target, probe performs local observation, and gather transfers accessible stock; none supplies the requested bounded physical search with conditional collection and stopping rules. Reuse those implementations explicitly. The supplied observations include both empty plants and previously observed stocked plants, so the assertion that all observed plants are empty is not reliable; every candidate must be checked at execution, without guaranteeing a harvest.\",\"specification\":\"General operation: bounded resource search and collection, parameterized by known resource type, origin, search radius, maximum actual path distance, elapsed-time limit, energy budget, minimum energy reserve and quantity cap. Submit its missing controller to the existing current-conversation development handoff. Dependencies: reuse navigate (base:navigate:1, kernel.navigate, foundation-forest@1), probe (open-baseline:probe:1), and gather (base:gather:1); obtain their complete execution contracts in that handoff rather than inventing replacements. Record these dependencies as code reuse. Prerequisites: living actor able to travel and observe, individually learned controller and usable dependency capabilities, locally identifiable target resource, reachable terrain, and sufficient energy and carrying capacity. No tool is required for exposed berries if gather permits hand collection. No permission to take another person's property is inferred.\\nFor Kai, use resource berry, origin (131.1,16.91), radius 4 world-distance units, at most 4 cumulative actual travel-distance units, at most 16 simulation-time units, at most 16 energy spent, energy floor 24, and at most four collected units. These are ceilings, not prepaid charges or promises of completion. Use the observed, closer commons-berry-3-0 at (130.84,18.71) as the first candidate only if still locally identifiable and reachable; its recorded stock is not a reservation. Other supplied source references are forest-berry-4, start-5-berries and commons-berry-4-0. Sources outside the radius cannot be pursued. Never expose unobserved sources or inspect remote stock through the controller.\\nExecute one active controller per actor. Inspect currently perceived candidates, order known candidates by feasible travel cost, and move through navigate toward an accessible interaction point, respecting collision geometry and actual source interaction range. If no viable known candidate remains, bounded local exploration may select reachable, not-yet-inspected positions using observed terrain only. Reveal objects only through actual perception at the actor's position; use probe for deliberate inspection. Lack of a known route is not permission to cross an obstacle. Stop when the quantity cap is met, any budget would be exceeded, health or mobility makes continuation unsafe, no permitted reachable candidate or exploration position remains, or the actor cancels. There is no requirement to continue after an unsuccessful bounded search.\\nCharge actual movement at navigate's distance-times-2 energy rate with its real carried-mass modifier and speed 0.8 distance per simulation-time unit. Observation uses probe's one-round duration and 0.2 energy observation mode; do not invoke its destructive sample-testing mode. Harvesting costs gather's 2 energy per unit, consumes its actual execution time, and requires current reachable, ripe, available stock and inventory capacity. Before each step or harvest unit, check its cost against every remaining budget and the reserve; if safe bounded execution cannot be established, stop instead of starting that step. For the elapsed-time ceiling, use dependency durations from the implementation contract and normal world scheduling, never zero-time harvesting. Hunger, climate and other ongoing world processes continue normally during execution. No energy is restored by searching and no berry is eaten automatically. The known berry nutrition of 8 and toxicity of 0 apply only if a separate valid consumption later occurs.\\nSuccessful gathering atomically subtracts n real berry units from the current source and adds exactly n to the actor's inventory, with 0 <= n <= remaining quantity cap and available stock. Revalidate stock, access, reach and ownership at transfer time; concurrent actors may deplete a source first. No stock, accelerated growth, food identification, rights, or mastery is created. Observation consumes no material. Track origin, resolved source IDs, current phase, actually traversed path, visited observation positions, elapsed time, energy charged, inspected facts and completed transfers. Emit start, movement, observation, transfer and stopped/completed events with actual outcomes and stop reasons. Completion may mean an exhausted search with zero berries, not a successful harvest.\\nInterruption pauses at a safe substep boundary while retaining completed work and charges. Resume requires a deliberate actor action and revalidates position, routes, remaining budgets, stock and all prerequisites; ordinary elapsed world time since starting still counts toward the time ceiling. Global simulation pauses and development/review waiting do not advance time or processes. Cancellation releases only surviving unconsumed escrow once and cancels any active dependency work under its execution contract; never refund spent time, energy or completed transfers. Death terminates the controller, resolves unconsumed escrow through normal death handling and leaves completed inventory subject to ordinary death rules, without duplication or a special inheritance grant. No recurring process remains after stopping, and no maintenance cost applies outside active execution. Implementation and review do not execute this operation or direct another participant's actions.\",\"learning\":1,\"experienceReview\":\"Functional success is actual information obtained or stock transferred, assessed separately from enjoyment. Do not award pleasure or maintained satisfaction merely for requesting, developing, learning, querying, naming, starting, finishing a timer or displaying a success label. A directly verified observation, including discovering that an accessible source is depleted or a path blocked, may be recorded as information gain; repeat reports of the same unchanged fact are functionally deduplicated. This minimal implementation grants no new mood reward or satisfaction accrual, so it needs no invented reward account or uncapped novelty bonus. Any future experiential benefit must use established event-based eligibility, personal applicability, amount caps, decay and cooldown rules in code. Do not change protected reward accounts, goals, permissions or budget systems. Physical comfort is not generated, its cap remains 10, and ordinary nutrition is not reduced by mood.\",\"visualReview\":\"Reuse actual actor movement, probe observation and gather transfer visuals rather than depicting instant discovery or spawning berries. Supply reusable event metadata: operation instance, actor ID, phase, timestamp, actual location, observed source ID when available, resource type, observed availability, transferred quantity, cumulative distance/energy/time, and stop reason. Render progress from committed execution state only. Source stock visuals update only after a real observation or committed transfer under ordinary visibility rules. Failed paths show blocked/stopped movement, empty inspections show no harvest, and a zero-yield completed search shows an honest unsuccessful-search result. Never show a filled inventory, picked berries, mastery badge or harvest-success effect before the corresponding real event. Visual feedback itself grants no functional or experiential reward.\"}]}"}
